interface Box<T> { value: T; independent: number }
type Direct = Box<Direct>['value'];
type Independent = Box<Independent>['independent'];
type Keys = keyof Box<Keys>;
type Reversed = Indirect['value'];
type Indirect = Box<Reversed>;
interface NumericValue<T extends { value: number }> { value: T }
type BadConstraint = NumericValue<BadConstraint>;
type Nested = Box<NestedLink>;
type NestedLink = Box<Nested>['value']['value'];
type Compared = Box<ComparedLink>;
type ComparedLink = Box<Compared>['value'] extends { value: string } ? never : Box<Compared>['value'];
type NeverTest = Box<NeverLink>;
type NeverLink = Box<NeverTest>['value'] extends never ? never : Box<NeverTest>['value'];
type TupleObject = Box<TupleObjectLink>;
type TupleObjectLink = [Box<TupleObject>['value']] extends [object] ? Box<TupleObject>['value'] : never;
type TupleUnknown = Box<TupleUnknownLink>;
type TupleUnknownLink = [Box<TupleUnknown>['value']] extends [unknown] ? Box<TupleUnknown>['value'] : never;
type TupleAny = Box<TupleAnyLink>;
type TupleAnyLink = [Box<TupleAny>['value']] extends [any] ? Box<TupleAny>['value'] : never;
type NestedArray = Box<NestedArrayLink>;
type NestedArrayLink = Box<NestedArray>['value'][] extends object[] ? Box<NestedArray>['value'] : never;
type NestedObject = Box<NestedObjectLink>;
type NestedObjectLink = { item: Box<NestedObject>['value'] } extends { item: object } ? Box<NestedObject>['value'] : never;
interface EmptyInterface {}
type NonEmpty = Box<NonEmptyLink>;
type NonEmptyLink = Box<NonEmpty>['value'] & { extra: number } extends object ? Box<NonEmpty>['value'] : never;
type WithInterface = Box<WithInterfaceLink>;
type WithInterfaceLink = Box<WithInterface>['value'] & EmptyInterface extends object ? Box<WithInterface>['value'] : never;
type NonNull<T> = T & {};
const invalid: NonNull<string | null> = null;
type PrimitiveCheck = Box<PrimitiveCheckLink>;
type PrimitiveCheckLink = Box<PrimitiveCheck>['value'] & object extends number ? Box<PrimitiveCheck>['value'] : never;
type ReversePrimitive = Box<ReversePrimitiveLink>;
type ReversePrimitiveLink = object & Box<ReversePrimitive>['value'] extends string ? never : Box<ReversePrimitive>['value'];
type ObjectCheck = Box<ObjectCheckLink>;
type ObjectCheckLink = Box<ObjectCheck>['value'] & object extends object ? Box<ObjectCheck>['value'] : never;
interface RequiredBox<T extends { value: any }> { value: T }
type InvalidConstraint = RequiredBox<InvalidLink>;
type InvalidLink = RequiredBox<InvalidConstraint>['value'] | number;
type KeysMapped = Box<KeysMappedLink>;
type KeysMappedLink = keyof Readonly<Box<KeysMapped>['value']>;
type IndexedMapped = Box<IndexedMappedLink>;
type IndexedMappedLink = Readonly<Box<IndexedMapped>['value']>['value'];
type ComparedMapped = Box<ComparedMappedLink>;
type ComparedMappedLink = Readonly<Box<ComparedMapped>['value']> extends {value?: unknown} ? Box<ComparedMapped>['value'] : never;
